shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded area extending from the x-axis to a function graph over a selected x-interval. On the left, use the larger blue region above the x-axis from the positive crossing to the right edge at x = 6. On the right, use the gray fill under the reciprocal-power curve to the right of the vertical line at x = 1, marked “area = ∞.”
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the portion of the area measured between the upper curve and the x-axis over the indicated interval. Right image: It identifies an area under the curve over the unbounded interval starting at 1.
Rationales: The graph and axis determine the vertical extent of the area, while the edges of the shaded patch determine the horizontal interval.
